items.title: *** EDPS and University of Oxford's Institute for Ethics in AI establish collaboration ***
items.description: *** EDPS and University of Oxford's Institute for Ethics in AI establish collaboration *** The # EDPS and the University of Oxford’s Institute for Ethics in AI launched a new collaboration today 🤝. At the launch event, ‘Contemporary challenges, ancient wisdom: philosophy meets AI policy’, @ Secretary_General Leonardo Cervera-Navas underlined in his opening remarks that the digital transformation of our societies must remain anchored in public values, not driven solely by capability, scale or speed. Personal data, he noted, is connected to the person and must be judged against the standard of human dignity. The collaboration will be a structured exchange between academic research and institutional practice. It will draw on philosophical traditions, both western and eastern, to inform debates on AI governance, privacy and data protection, human agency, rights, power and human flourishing. The EDPS will pose questions arising from modern AI governance. The Institute will reply from the perspective of philosophers, in a series of written dialogues.
